security updates: CVE-2026-47766: do not follow rootfs /dev symlinks. Open rootfs /dev with safe_openat before creating default or handler-specific devices, preventing rootfs-controlled /dev symlinks from redirecting device setup outside the container rootfs.
CVE-2026-30892: fix parsing in `crun exec -u` that could lead to the process running with the wrong user.
krun: fix CVE-2025-24965. The .krun_config.json file could be created outside of the container rootfs.
there was recently a security vulnerability (CVE-2024-21626) in runc
Fix CVE-2022-27650: exec does not set inheritable capabilities.
fix for CVE-2019-16884, make sure writes to /proc for the SELinux and AppArmor labels are on procfs
